title: Legacy discovery scanner
goal: Inventory an existing codebase read-only: the first deliverable of every transformation.
acceptance: `pnpm factory discover <git-url-or-path>` clones read-only and outputs JSON listing services, frontends, frameworks and versions, HTTP endpoints, pipelines, Dockerfiles and dependencies
Detectors exist for Angular, React, NestJS, Express, Spring Boot and FastAPI, each with fixture repos in tests
Duplicated code hotspots are reported (jscpd or equivalent)
The scanner never writes to the scanned repo (test asserts no changes)

title: Factory Readiness score
goal: One number and a checklist per repo that shows how far it is from the factory.
acceptance: Scoring rules (documented in docs/readiness.md) cover: specs present, contract tests, generated vs hand-written code ratio, shared pipeline blocks, signed artifacts, SBOMs, test coverage
`pnpm factory readiness <repo>` outputs a 0–100 score with per-rule evidence, using discovery output
The control plane stores scores over time and `products/readiness-remote` shows the trend and the top fixes
Tests pin scores for three fixture repos

title: Spec extraction: draft OpenAPI materials from existing services
goal: Turn legacy APIs into materials without rewriting them.
acceptance: For NestJS and Express fixtures, `pnpm factory extract-api <service>` produces an OpenAPI draft from routes, DTOs and validators (static analysis first, agent-assisted gaps marked TODO)
Output is created as a material in Draft state with a PR for human review
A contract test generated from the draft passes against the running fixture service

title: Token extraction: draft design tokens from existing CSS
goal: Start a legacy frontend's design system material from what it already uses.
acceptance: `pnpm factory extract-tokens <app>` clusters colors, spacing, radii and font sizes from CSS/SCSS into W3C DTCG JSON
Near-duplicates are merged with a report of what was merged
Style Dictionary builds CSS variables from the draft; a fixture app renders the same before and after (visual test)

title: Legacy recipe: wrap an existing app as a product
goal: Give legacy apps the factory's gates without regenerating them.
acceptance: `recipes/legacy` registers an existing repo as a product with a product.yaml that has no skeleton
It adds the shared Dagger blocks for SBOM, scan and signing to the app's pipeline
The app appears in the catalog and the material graph with its dependencies
Fixture legacy app goes from unregistered to signed image in one run

title: Contract the edges of a legacy system
goal: Make legacy code safe to change before replacing it.
acceptance: For each extracted API with known consumers, a contract test project is generated and runs in the legacy app's pipeline
A breaking change in the fixture legacy service is caught by the generated tests
The readiness score's contract-test rule picks the tests up

title: Context packs as a material type
goal: Versioned, tested context for coding agents, emitted from the factory's own sources.
acceptance: Material type `context-pack` with an emitter that builds AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md fragments and skill folders from: repo conventions, the component catalog, material specs and recipes
Context packs are versioned and released like other materials
promptfoo eval suite runs three fixture tasks with and without the pack and reports the difference
Eval runs nightly; a drop below the last release's score blocks the next pack release

title: MCP server emitter from OpenAPI
goal: Every API material becomes agent tools automatically.
acceptance: `emitters/mcp-server` generates a TypeScript MCP server exposing one tool per OpenAPI operation, with schemas from the spec
Read-only operations and write operations are separated; write tools are off unless enabled in config
Generated server for orders-api passes an MCP protocol conformance test and calls the running orders-service

title: Derived-code lineage: record inputs behind every generated or agent-written change
goal: The recall-for-derived-code capability: know which code came from which spec, emitter, rule or model.
acceptance: Emitter runs and agent sessions write a signed lineage attestation per commit (git notes): material versions, emitter versions, context-pack version, model id, prompt hash
Claude Code hooks capture agent-session lineage; emitters capture codegen lineage
The graph service ingests lineage and links files to inputs
`pnpm factory lineage --input context-pack@1.2.0` lists every file and product derived from that input

title: Recall workflow in the control plane
goal: Flow C end to end: mark an input bad and drive exposure to zero.
acceptance: Temporal workflow `recall` takes any input (material version, emitter version, context-pack version), finds affected code via lineage and the graph, and opens regenerate or fix PRs
`products/recalls-remote` shows open recalls with remaining exposure per product, falling to zero as PRs merge
Kyverno blocks deploys of recalled images during the recall
End-to-end test: recall a fixture emitter version and watch exposure reach zero

title: Model gateway integration for the AI workforce
goal: Route agent tasks to models by cost and quality.
acceptance: The agent runner calls models through a configurable gateway (Frugal Layer or any OpenAI-compatible router)
Routing rules by task type are configured as a material
Per-team token cost is reported to the control plane insights

title: Transformation report generator
goal: The customer-facing output of a discovery engagement.
acceptance: `pnpm factory report <org>` produces an HTML report: inventory, readiness scores, duplication hotspots, extracted materials, recommended first products and a 90-day plan
Report renders from fixture data with no network access
Snapshot test of the report structure

title: Gate 4 package: pilot playbook
goal: Everything needed to run a paid transformation pilot.
acceptance: docs/pilot-playbook.md: scope, week-by-week plan, success metrics (readiness score delta, lead time, change failure rate), and exit report template
A full dry run on an open-source legacy app (chosen and recorded in DECISIONS.md) produces discovery, readiness, extracted materials, a wrapped product and a report
PROGRESS.md records the evidence and the planner opens `Gate 4 review` for a human

title: Living docs generated from specs and the material graph
goal: Our answer to Factory AutoWiki: documentation that is rebuilt on every merge from specs, recipes and the graph, so it describes intent and dependencies, not just code.
acceptance: `factory docs build` generates a static site: one page per material (spec reference, versions, consumers, emitters), per product (recipe, materials consumed, deploy and SLOs, owners) and per recipe, plus an architecture diagram of products and materials from the graph
API reference pages render from the OpenAPI and AsyncAPI specs; diagrams are generated (Mermaid), not hand-drawn
The docs rebuild on merge to main (workflow provided in tools/factory/ci/ for a human to copy) and link from the catalog
A test asserts every material and product in the repo has a page and no page links to a missing one
`pnpm nx affected -t lint test build --base=origin/main` exits 0
scope: tools/factory docs command, docs site template, tools/factory/ci/.

title: AI review gate in the gate center
goal: Code review as a governed gate: an AI reviewer that uses the customer's own context packs, reports only blocking problems with evidence, and is measured like any other gate.
acceptance: A gate plugin `ai-review` implements the Gate contract: input is the PR diff, linked issue and the product's context pack; output is pass, warn or fail with per-finding file, line, problem and fix
Model calls go through the model gateway (P4-11); the model and context-pack versions are recorded in the gate result for lineage
Findings post as PR comments and appear in the gate center; a waiver works like any other gate
An eval set of at least 20 fixture PRs (known-good and known-bad) measures precision and recall; the gate only fails PRs when precision on the eval set is at least 80%, otherwise it warns
`pnpm nx affected -t lint test build --base=origin/main` exits 0
scope: gates plugin package, control-plane-api gate ingestion, evals/.
